## LLM018 Streaming endpoint without produces

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | yes: `--fix` (or `--fix --write` to apply it) |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm018 |
| Turn it off | `LLM018: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM018` on the command line |

Returning Flux without produces makes Spring go through the Jackson JSON converter: it drains the whole stream and writes it out at once, and proxies are more likely to buffer the response — streaming was enabled for nothing.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM018` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm018 -->

## What it looks like

A streaming endpoint returning `SseEmitter` / `Flux` with no `produces` attribute.

## How to fix

Add `produces = MediaType.TEXT_EVENT_STREAM_VALUE` so the content type and charset are right and proxies stream instead of buffering.
